title: Introduce hopwise-decay probe scheduler and traffic-tempering rollout guard
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: We observed several transient throughput bursts in production where existing canary probes either (a) over-injected traffic and amplified noise (causing false positives), or (b) used coarse fixed-window decay which reacted too slowly to quick phase-shifts. This PR adds two complementary safeguards: 1) a hopwise-decay probe scheduler that decomposes probing windows into hop segments with exponentially decayed weights to prioritize recent samples while retaining historical context; 2) a traffic-tempering rollout guard that dynamically limits probe injection and rate of traffic increase based on short-term volatility metrics.
